preconditions.description: Input x is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(num) <= int(stdin.strip()) for num in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == 2)
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or two integers a and b within [1, x] separated by space.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda a_b: (a_b[0] % a_b[1] == 0) and (a_b[0] * a_b[1] > int(stdin.strip())) and (a_b[0] / a_b[1] < int(stdin.strip())))(list(map(int, stdout.strip().split())))
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', then a and b satisfy: b divides a, a*b > x, and a/b < x.
